    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Agendas and Minutes</h1>

<p>Murrindindi Shire Council holds a Council Meeting on the fourth Wednesday of each month, starting at 6.00 pm. From time to time, an unscheduled Council Meeting may also be held. Any additional meetings will be advertised on this website.</p>
<p>Council Meeting agendas are generally available for download on the Friday before the meeting. Minutes and the audio recording of the meeting are generally available on the Friday following the meeting.</p>
<p>Recordings of Council Meetings remain the property of Council. Permission from the Chief Executive Officer is required before any recording can be broadcast or distributed.</p>

<script>
(function () {
  // ====== CONFIGURE: your Copilot Studio web channel URL ======
  // Copilot Studio > Channels > Custom website > copy the iframe src
  var BOT_URL = "https://copilotstudio.microsoft.com/environments/Default-178eb3ff-b26c-4882-bec3-48150c87263c/bots/crf5e_murrindindiCouncilAssistant/webchat?__version__=2";

  var launcher  = document.getElementById("mscVaLauncher");
  var panel     = document.getElementById("mscVaPanel");
  var frame     = document.getElementById("mscVaFrame");
  var closeBtn  = document.getElementById("mscVaClose");
  var loaded    = false;
  var lastFocus = null;

  function openChat() {
    if (!loaded) {                 // lazy-load: no iframe traffic until first open
      frame.src = BOT_URL;
      loaded = true;
    }
    lastFocus = document.activeElement;
    panel.hidden = false;
    panel.classList.add("msc-va-open");
    launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
    launcher.style.display = "none";
    closeBtn.focus();
  }

  function closeChat() {
    panel.classList.remove("msc-va-open");
    panel.hidden = true;
    launcher.style.display = "flex";
    launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    (lastFocus || launcher).focus();
  }

  launcher.addEventListener("click", openChat);
  closeBtn.addEventListener("click", closeChat);
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && panel.classList.contains("msc-va-open")) closeChat();
  });

  /* ====== OFFICE HOURS STATUS (green = open, red = closed) ======
     Computed in Australia/Melbourne time regardless of the visitor's
     device timezone. CONFIRM these hours against the Customer Service
     Charter before go-live, and update HOLIDAYS each year. */
  var HOURS = {
    // 0=Sun ... 6=Sat. null = closed all day. [openMins, closeMins] from midnight.
    0: null,
    1: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],   // Mon 8:30am – 5:00pm
    2: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    3: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    4: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    5: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],   // Fri
    6: null
  };
  // Victorian public holidays — maintain annually (Grand Final Friday TBC each year)
  var HOLIDAYS = [
    "2026-01-01", "2026-01-26", "2026-03-09",
    "2026-04-03", "2026-04-04", "2026-04-06", "2026-04-25",
    "2026-06-08", "2026-11-03", "2026-12-25", "2026-12-28"
  ];
  var PHONE = "(03) 5772 0333";

  function melbourneNow() {
    var parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
      timeZone: "Australia/Melbourne",
      year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit",
      hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: false, weekday: "short"
    }).formatToParts(new Date());
    var p = {};
    parts.forEach(function (x) { p[x.type] = x.value; });
    var days = { Sun: 0, Mon: 1, Tue: 2, Wed: 3, Thu: 4, Fri: 5, Sat: 6 };
    return {
      dateStr: p.year + "-" + p.month + "-" + p.day,
      day: days[p.weekday],
      mins: parseInt(p.hour, 10) * 60 + parseInt(p.minute, 10)
    };
  }

    var pill = document.getElementById("mscVaHours");
    var text = document.getElementById("mscVaHoursText");
    if (!pill || !text) return;
    var now = melbourneNow();
    var span = HOURS[now.day];
    var isHoliday = HOLIDAYS.indexOf(now.dateStr) !== -1;
    var open = !isHoliday && span && now.mins >= span[0] && now.mins < span[1];
    pill.classList.toggle("is-open", open);
    pill.classList.toggle("is-closed", !open);
    text.textContent = open
      ? "Council offices are open"
      : "Council offices are closed \u2013 I\u2019m here 24/7, or call " + PHONE;
  }

  setInterval(updateHours, 60000); // re-check every minute

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Agendas and Minutes</h1>

<p>Murrindindi Shire Council holds a Council Meeting on the fourth Wednesday of each month, starting at 6.00 pm. From time to time, an unscheduled Council Meeting may also be held. Any additional meetings will be advertised on this website.</p>
<p>Council Meeting agendas are generally available for download on the Friday before the meeting. Minutes and the audio recording of the meeting are generally available on the Friday following the meeting.</p>
<p>Recordings of Council Meetings remain the property of Council. Permission from the Chief Executive Officer is required before any recording can be broadcast or distributed.</p>

<script>

  function closeChat() {
    panel.classList.remove("msc-va-open");
    panel.hidden = true;
    launcher.style.display = "flex";
    launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    (lastFocus || launcher).focus();
  }

  launcher.addEventListener("click", openChat);
  closeBtn.addEventListener("click", closeChat);
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && panel.classList.contains("msc-va-open")) closeChat();
  });

  /* ====== OFFICE HOURS STATUS (green = open, red = closed) ======
     Computed in Australia/Melbourne time regardless of the visitor's
     device timezone. CONFIRM these hours against the Customer Service
     Charter before go-live, and update HOLIDAYS each year. */
  var HOURS = {
    // 0=Sun ... 6=Sat. null = closed all day. [openMins, closeMins] from midnight.
    0: null,
    1: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],   // Mon 8:30am – 5:00pm
    2: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    3: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    4: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    5: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],   // Fri
    6: null
  };
  // Victorian public holidays — maintain annually (Grand Final Friday TBC each year)
  var HOLIDAYS = [
    "2026-01-01", "2026-01-26", "2026-03-09",
    "2026-04-03", "2026-04-04", "2026-04-06", "2026-04-25",
    "2026-06-08", "2026-11-03", "2026-12-25", "2026-12-28"
  ];
  var PHONE = "(03) 5772 0333";

  function melbourneNow() {
    var parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
      timeZone: "Australia/Melbourne",
      year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit",
      hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: false, weekday: "short"
    }).formatToParts(new Date());
    var p = {};
    parts.forEach(function (x) { p[x.type] = x.value; });
    var days = { Sun: 0, Mon: 1, Tue: 2, Wed: 3, Thu: 4, Fri: 5, Sat: 6 };
    return {
      dateStr: p.year + "-" + p.month + "-" + p.day,
      day: days[p.weekday],
      mins: parseInt(p.hour, 10) * 60 + parseInt(p.minute, 10)
    };
  }

  function updateHours() {
    var pill = document.getElementById("mscVaHours");
    var text = document.getElementById("mscVaHoursText");
    if (!pill || !text) return;
    var now = melbourneNow();
    var span = HOURS[now.day];
    var isHoliday = HOLIDAYS.indexOf(now.dateStr) !== -1;
    var open = !isHoliday && span && now.mins >= span[0] && now.mins < span[1];
    pill.classList.toggle("is-open", open);
    pill.classList.toggle("is-closed", !open);
    text.textContent = open
      ? "Council offices are open"
      : "Council offices are closed \u2013 I\u2019m here 24/7, or call " + PHONE;
  }

  updateHours();
  setInterval(updateHours, 60000); // re-check every minute
})();

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Agendas and Minutes</h1>

<p>Murrindindi Shire Council holds a Council Meeting on the fourth Wednesday of each month, starting at 6.00 pm. From time to time, an unscheduled Council Meeting may also be held. Any additional meetings will be advertised on this website.</p>
<p>Council Meeting agendas are generally available for download on the Friday before the meeting. Minutes and the audio recording of the meeting are generally available on the Friday following the meeting.</p>
<p>Recordings of Council Meetings remain the property of Council. Permission from the Chief Executive Officer is required before any recording can be broadcast or distributed.</p>

  --msc-crop: 64px;

}

/* ----- Launcher: glossy 3D orb + label pill ----- */
.msc-va-launcher {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 26px;
  right: 60px;
  z-index: 9999;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 8px 22px 8px 8px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 18px !important;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--msc-purple) 0%, var(--msc-purple-deep) 100%);
  color: var(--msc-white);
  font-family: var(--msc-font);
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.25;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25) inset,
    0 -3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.25) inset,
    var(--msc-shadow-2),
    0 24px 40px -18px rgba(0,40,28,.45);
  animation: msc-va-float 3.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  transition: transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
}
.msc-va-launcher:hover,
.msc-va-launcher:focus-visible {
  transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.04);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--msc-purple-bright) 0%, var(--msc-purple) 100%);
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25) inset,
    0 -3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.25) inset,
    var(--msc-shadow-3),
    0 0 0 3px rgba(247,150,28,.55),
    0 0 24px rgba(247,150,28,.45);
  animation-play-state: paused;
  outline: none;
}
.msc-va-launcher:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--msc-gold); outline-offset: 3px; }

.msc-va-orb {
  position: relative;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 46px; height: 46px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 30% 25%, #FFE9A8 0%, var(--msc-gold-soft) 22%, var(--msc-gold) 55%, #B97F00 100%);
  box-shadow:
    inset -4px -6px 10px rgba(90,55,0,.45),
    inset 3px 4px 6px rgba(255,255,255,.55),
    0 5px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.30);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  transition: transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, filter .2s ease;
}
.msc-va-orb::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 5px; left: 9px;
  width: 16px; height: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.75);
  filter: blur(2px);
  transform: rotate(-22deg);
}
.msc-va-orb svg { width: 23px; height: 23px; fill: #3A2A00; position: relative; transition: transform .2s ease; }
.msc-va-launcher:hover .msc-va-orb,
.msc-va-launcher:focus-visible .msc-va-orb {
  transform: scale(1.12) rotate(-6deg);
  filter: brightness(1.12) saturate(1.15);
  box-shadow:
    inset -4px -6px 10px rgba(90,55,0,.45),
    inset 3px 4px 6px rgba(255,255,255,.65),
    0 5px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.35),
    0 0 18px rgba(247,150,28,.6);
}
.msc-va-launcher:hover .msc-va-orb svg,
.msc-va-launcher:focus-visible .msc-va-orb svg { transform: scale(1.1); }

.msc-va-label small { display: block; font-weight: 400; font-size: 12px; opacity: .9; }

.msc-va-launcher::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -2px; right: 4px;
  width: 12px; height: 12px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, var(--msc-gold-soft), var(--msc-gold) 70%);
  border: 2px solid var(--msc-purple-deep);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(242,169,0,.55);
  animation: msc-va-pulse 2.4s ease-out infinite;
}

@keyframes msc-va-float { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-7px); } }
@keyframes msc-va-pulse {
  0%   { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(242,169,0,.55); }
  70%  { box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgba(242,169,0,0); }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(242,169,0,0); }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .msc-va-launcher, .msc-va-launcher::after { animation: none; }

/* ----- Chat panel ----- */
.msc-va-panel {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 26px;
  right: 26px;
  z-index: 10000;
  width: 410px;
  max-width: calc(100vw - 32px);
  height: 640px;
  max-height: calc(100vh - 52px);
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-radius: 18px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--msc-white);
  box-shadow: var(--msc-shadow-3), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,61,44,.08);

}
.msc-va-panel.msc-va-open { display: flex; animation: msc-va-pop .22s ease-out; }
@keyframes msc-va-pop {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px) scale(.96); }

<script>
(function () {
  // ====== CONFIGURE: your Copilot Studio web channel URL ======
  // Copilot Studio > Channels > Custom website > copy the iframe src
  var BOT_URL = "https://copilotstudio.microsoft.com/environments/Default-178eb3ff-b26c-4882-bec3-48150c87263c/bots/crf5e_murrindindiCouncilAssistant/webchat?__version__=2";

  var launcher  = document.getElementById("mscVaLauncher");
  var panel     = document.getElementById("mscVaPanel");
  var frame     = document.getElementById("mscVaFrame");
  var closeBtn  = document.getElementById("mscVaClose");
  var loaded    = false;
  var lastFocus = null;

  function openChat() {
    if (!loaded) {                 // lazy-load: no iframe traffic until first open
      frame.src = BOT_URL;
      loaded = true;
    }
    lastFocus = document.activeElement;
    panel.hidden = false;
    panel.classList.add("msc-va-open");
    launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
    launcher.style.display = "none";
    closeBtn.focus();
  }

  function closeChat() {
    panel.classList.remove("msc-va-open");
    panel.hidden = true;
    launcher.style.display = "flex";
    launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    (lastFocus || launcher).focus();
  }

  launcher.addEventListener("click", openChat);
  closeBtn.addEventListener("click", closeChat);
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && panel.classList.contains("msc-va-open")) closeChat();
  });

  /* ====== OFFICE HOURS STATUS (green = open, red = closed) ======
     Computed in Australia/Melbourne time regardless of the visitor's
     device timezone. CONFIRM these hours against the Customer Service
     Charter before go-live, and update HOLIDAYS each year. */
  var HOURS = {
    // 0=Sun ... 6=Sat. null = closed all day. [openMins, closeMins] from midnight.
    0: null,
    1: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],   // Mon 8:30am – 5:00pm
    2: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    3: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    4: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    5: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],   // Fri
    6: null
  };
  // Victorian public holidays — maintain annually (Grand Final Friday TBC each year)
  var HOLIDAYS = [
    "2026-01-01", "2026-01-26", "2026-03-09",
    "2026-04-03", "2026-04-04", "2026-04-06", "2026-04-25",
    "2026-06-08", "2026-11-03", "2026-12-25", "2026-12-28"
  ];
  var PHONE = "(03) 5772 0333";

  function melbourneNow() {
    var parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
      timeZone: "Australia/Melbourne",
      year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit",
      hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: false, weekday: "short"
    }).formatToParts(new Date());
    var p = {};
    parts.forEach(function (x) { p[x.type] = x.value; });
    var days = { Sun: 0, Mon: 1, Tue: 2, Wed: 3, Thu: 4, Fri: 5, Sat: 6 };
    return {
      dateStr: p.year + "-" + p.month + "-" + p.day,
      day: days[p.weekday],
      mins: parseInt(p.hour, 10) * 60 + parseInt(p.minute, 10)
    };
  }

  function updateHours() {
    var pill = document.getElementById("mscVaHours");
    var text = document.getElementById("mscVaHoursText");
    if (!pill || !text) return;
    var now = melbourneNow();
    var span = HOURS[now.day];
    var isHoliday = HOLIDAYS.indexOf(now.dateStr) !== -1;
    var open = !isHoliday && span && now.mins >= span[0] && now.mins < span[1];
    pill.classList.toggle("is-open", open);
    pill.classList.toggle("is-closed", !open);
    text.textContent = open
      ? "Council offices are open"
      : "Council offices are closed \u2013 I\u2019m here 24/7, or call " + PHONE;
  }

  updateHours();
  setInterval(updateHours, 60000); // re-check every minute
})();
</script>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Agendas and Minutes</h1>

<p>Murrindindi Shire Council holds a Council Meeting on the fourth Wednesday of each month, starting at 6.00 pm. From time to time, an unscheduled Council Meeting may also be held. Any additional meetings will be advertised on this website.</p>
<p>Council Meeting agendas are generally available for download on the Friday before the meeting. Minutes and the audio recording of the meeting are generally available on the Friday following the meeting.</p>
<p>Recordings of Council Meetings remain the property of Council. Permission from the Chief Executive Officer is required before any recording can be broadcast or distributed.</p>

<script>
(function () {
  // ====== CONFIGURE: your Copilot Studio web channel URL ======
  // Copilot Studio > Channels > Custom website > copy the iframe src
  var BOT_URL = "https://copilotstudio.microsoft.com/environments/Default-178eb3ff-b26c-4882-bec3-48150c87263c/bots/crf5e_murrindindiCouncilAssistant/webchat?__version__=2";

  var launcher  = document.getElementById("mscVaLauncher");
  var panel     = document.getElementById("mscVaPanel");
  var frame     = document.getElementById("mscVaFrame");
  var closeBtn  = document.getElementById("mscVaClose");
  var loaded    = false;
  var lastFocus = null;

  function openChat() {
    if (!loaded) {                 // lazy-load: no iframe traffic until first open
      frame.src = BOT_URL;
      loaded = true;
    }
    lastFocus = document.activeElement;
    panel.hidden = false;
    panel.classList.add("msc-va-open");
    launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
    launcher.style.display = "none";
    closeBtn.focus();
  }

  function closeChat() {
    panel.classList.remove("msc-va-open");
    panel.hidden = true;
    launcher.style.display = "flex";
    launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    (lastFocus || launcher).focus();
  }

  launcher.addEventListener("click", openChat);
  closeBtn.addEventListener("click", closeChat);
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && panel.classList.contains("msc-va-open")) closeChat();
  });

  /* ====== OFFICE HOURS STATUS (green = open, red = closed) ======
     Computed in Australia/Melbourne time regardless of the visitor's
     device timezone. CONFIRM these hours against the Customer Service
     Charter before go-live, and update HOLIDAYS each year. */
  var HOURS = {
    // 0=Sun ... 6=Sat. null = closed all day. [openMins, closeMins] from midnight.
    0: null,
    1: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],   // Mon 8:30am – 5:00pm
    2: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    3: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    4: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    5: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],   // Fri
    6: null
  };
  // Victorian public holidays — maintain annually (Grand Final Friday TBC each year)
  var HOLIDAYS = [
    "2026-01-01", "2026-01-26", "2026-03-09",
    "2026-04-03", "2026-04-04", "2026-04-06", "2026-04-25",
    "2026-06-08", "2026-11-03", "2026-12-25", "2026-12-28"
  ];
  var PHONE = "(03) 5772 0333";

  function melbourneNow() {
    var parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
      timeZone: "Australia/Melbourne",
      year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit",
      hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: false, weekday: "short"
    }).formatToParts(new Date());
    var p = {};
    parts.forEach(function (x) { p[x.type] = x.value; });
    var days = { Sun: 0, Mon: 1, Tue: 2, Wed: 3, Thu: 4, Fri: 5, Sat: 6 };
    return {
      dateStr: p.year + "-" + p.month + "-" + p.day,
      day: days[p.weekday],
      mins: parseInt(p.hour, 10) * 60 + parseInt(p.minute, 10)
    };
  }

  function updateHours() {
    var pill = document.getElementById("mscVaHours");
    var text = document.getElementById("mscVaHoursText");
    if (!pill || !text) return;
    var now = melbourneNow();
    var span = HOURS[now.day];
    var isHoliday = HOLIDAYS.indexOf(now.dateStr) !== -1;
    var open = !isHoliday && span && now.mins >= span[0] && now.mins < span[1];
    pill.classList.toggle("is-open", open);
    pill.classList.toggle("is-closed", !open);
    text.textContent = open
      ? "Council offices are open"
      : "Council offices are closed \u2013 I\u2019m here 24/7, or call " + PHONE;
  }

  updateHours();
  setInterval(updateHours, 60000); // re-check every minute
})();
</script>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Agendas and Minutes</h1>

<p>Murrindindi Shire Council holds a Council Meeting on the fourth Wednesday of each month, starting at 6.00 pm. From time to time, an unscheduled Council Meeting may also be held. Any additional meetings will be advertised on this website.</p>
<p>Council Meeting agendas are generally available for download on the Friday before the meeting. Minutes and the audio recording of the meeting are generally available on the Friday following the meeting.</p>
<p>Recordings of Council Meetings remain the property of Council. Permission from the Chief Executive Officer is required before any recording can be broadcast or distributed.</p>

<script>
(function () {
  // ====== CONFIGURE: your Copilot Studio web channel URL ======
  // Copilot Studio > Channels > Custom website > copy the iframe src
  var BOT_URL = "https://copilotstudio.microsoft.com/environments/Default-178eb3ff-b26c-4882-bec3-48150c87263c/bots/crf5e_murrindindiCouncilAssistant/webchat?__version__=2";

  var launcher  = document.getElementById("mscVaLauncher");
  var panel     = document.getElementById("mscVaPanel");
  var frame     = document.getElementById("mscVaFrame");
  var closeBtn  = document.getElementById("mscVaClose");
  var loaded    = false;
  var lastFocus = null;

  function openChat() {
    if (!loaded) {                 // lazy-load: no iframe traffic until first open
      frame.src = BOT_URL;
      loaded = true;
    }
    lastFocus = document.activeElement;
    panel.hidden = false;
    panel.classList.add("msc-va-open");
    launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
    launcher.style.display = "none";
    closeBtn.focus();
  }

  function closeChat() {
    panel.classList.remove("msc-va-open");
    panel.hidden = true;
    launcher.style.display = "flex";
    launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    (lastFocus || launcher).focus();
  }

  launcher.addEventListener("click", openChat);
  closeBtn.addEventListener("click", closeChat);
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && panel.classList.contains("msc-va-open")) closeChat();
  });

  /* ====== OFFICE HOURS STATUS (green = open, red = closed) ======
     Computed in Australia/Melbourne time regardless of the visitor's
     device timezone. CONFIRM these hours against the Customer Service
     Charter before go-live, and update HOLIDAYS each year. */
  var HOURS = {
    // 0=Sun ... 6=Sat. null = closed all day. [openMins, closeMins] from midnight.
    0: null,
    1: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],   // Mon 8:30am – 5:00pm
    2: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    3: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    4: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    5: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],   // Fri
    6: null
  };
  // Victorian public holidays — maintain annually (Grand Final Friday TBC each year)
  var HOLIDAYS = [
    "2026-01-01", "2026-01-26", "2026-03-09",
    "2026-04-03", "2026-04-04", "2026-04-06", "2026-04-25",
    "2026-06-08", "2026-11-03", "2026-12-25", "2026-12-28"
  ];
  var PHONE = "(03) 5772 0333";

  function melbourneNow() {
    var parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
      timeZone: "Australia/Melbourne",
      year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit",
      hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: false, weekday: "short"
    }).formatToParts(new Date());
    var p = {};
    parts.forEach(function (x) { p[x.type] = x.value; });
    var days = { Sun: 0, Mon: 1, Tue: 2, Wed: 3, Thu: 4, Fri: 5, Sat: 6 };
    return {
      dateStr: p.year + "-" + p.month + "-" + p.day,
      day: days[p.weekday],
      mins: parseInt(p.hour, 10) * 60 + parseInt(p.minute, 10)
    };
  }

  function updateHours() {
    var pill = document.getElementById("mscVaHours");
    var text = document.getElementById("mscVaHoursText");
    if (!pill || !text) return;
    var now = melbourneNow();
    var span = HOURS[now.day];
    var isHoliday = HOLIDAYS.indexOf(now.dateStr) !== -1;
    var open = !isHoliday && span && now.mins >= span[0] && now.mins < span[1];
    pill.classList.toggle("is-open", open);
    pill.classList.toggle("is-closed", !open);
    text.textContent = open
      ? "Council offices are open"
      : "Council offices are closed \u2013 I\u2019m here 24/7, or call " + PHONE;
  }

  updateHours();
  setInterval(updateHours, 60000); // re-check every minute
})();
</script>

            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {

                }
            }, true);

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Agendas and Minutes</h1>

<p>Murrindindi Shire Council holds a Council Meeting on the fourth Wednesday of each month, starting at 6.00 pm. From time to time, an unscheduled Council Meeting may also be held. Any additional meetings will be advertised on this website.</p>
<p>Council Meeting agendas are generally available for download on the Friday before the meeting. Minutes and the audio recording of the meeting are generally available on the Friday following the meeting.</p>
<p>Recordings of Council Meetings remain the property of Council. Permission from the Chief Executive Officer is required before any recording can be broadcast or distributed.</p>

    0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25) inset,

}

  position: relative;

  width: 46px; height: 46px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 30% 25%, #FFE9A8 0%, var(--msc-gold-soft) 22%, var(--msc-gold) 55%, #B97F00 100%);
  box-shadow:
    inset -4px -6px 10px rgba(90,55,0,.45),
    inset 3px 4px 6px rgba(255,255,255,.55),
    0 5px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.30);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  transition: transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, filter .2s ease;
}
.msc-va-orb::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 5px; left: 9px;
  width: 16px; height: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;

}
.msc-va-launcher:hover .msc-va-orb svg,
.msc-va-launcher:focus-visible .msc-va-orb svg { transform: scale(1.1); }

.msc-va-label small { display: block; font-weight: 400; font-size: 12px; opacity: .9; }

.msc-va-launcher::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -2px; right: 4px;
  width: 12px; height: 12px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, var(--msc-gold-soft), var(--msc-gold) 70%);
  border: 2px solid var(--msc-purple-deep);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(242,169,0,.55);

}

@keyframes msc-va-float { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-7px); } }

}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

.msc-va-panel {

  var closeBtn  = document.getElementById("mscVaClose");
  var loaded    = false;
  var lastFocus = null;

  function openChat() {
    if (!loaded) {                 // lazy-load: no iframe traffic until first open
      frame.src = BOT_URL;
      loaded = true;
    }
    lastFocus = document.activeElement;
    panel.hidden = false;
    panel.classList.add("msc-va-open");
    launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
    launcher.style.display = "none";
    closeBtn.focus();
  }

  function closeChat() {
    panel.classList.remove("msc-va-open");
    panel.hidden = true;
    launcher.style.display = "flex";
    launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    (lastFocus || launcher).focus();
  }

  launcher.addEventListener("click", openChat);
  closeBtn.addEventListener("click", closeChat);
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && panel.classList.contains("msc-va-open")) closeChat();
  });

  /* ====== OFFICE HOURS STATUS (green = open, red = closed) ======
     Computed in Australia/Melbourne time regardless of the visitor's
     device timezone. CONFIRM these hours against the Customer Service
     Charter before go-live, and update HOLIDAYS each year. */
  var HOURS = {
    // 0=Sun ... 6=Sat. null = closed all day. [openMins, closeMins] from midnight.
    0: null,
    1: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],   // Mon 8:30am – 5:00pm
    2: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    3: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    4: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    5: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],   // Fri
    6: null
  };
  // Victorian public holidays — maintain annually (Grand Final Friday TBC each year)
  var HOLIDAYS = [
    "2026-01-01", "2026-01-26", "2026-03-09",
    "2026-04-03", "2026-04-04", "2026-04-06", "2026-04-25",
    "2026-06-08", "2026-11-03", "2026-12-25", "2026-12-28"
  ];
  var PHONE = "(03) 5772 0333";

  function melbourneNow() {
    var parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
      timeZone: "Australia/Melbourne",
      year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit",
      hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: false, weekday: "short"
    }).formatToParts(new Date());
    var p = {};
    parts.forEach(function (x) { p[x.type] = x.value; });
    var days = { Sun: 0, Mon: 1, Tue: 2, Wed: 3, Thu: 4, Fri: 5, Sat: 6 };
    return {
      dateStr: p.year + "-" + p.month + "-" + p.day,
      day: days[p.weekday],
      mins: parseInt(p.hour, 10) * 60 + parseInt(p.minute, 10)
    };
  }

  function updateHours() {
    var pill = document.getElementById("mscVaHours");
    var text = document.getElementById("mscVaHoursText");
    if (!pill || !text) return;
    var now = melbourneNow();
    var span = HOURS[now.day];
    var isHoliday = HOLIDAYS.indexOf(now.dateStr) !== -1;
    var open = !isHoliday && span && now.mins >= span[0] && now.mins < span[1];
    pill.classList.toggle("is-open", open);
    pill.classList.toggle("is-closed", !open);
    text.textContent = open
      ? "Council offices are open"
      : "Council offices are closed \u2013 I\u2019m here 24/7, or call " + PHONE;
  }

  updateHours();
  setInterval(updateHours, 60000); // re-check every minute
})();

        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Agendas and Minutes</h1>

<p>Murrindindi Shire Council holds a Council Meeting on the fourth Wednesday of each month, starting at 6.00 pm. From time to time, an unscheduled Council Meeting may also be held. Any additional meetings will be advertised on this website.</p>
<p>Council Meeting agendas are generally available for download on the Friday before the meeting. Minutes and the audio recording of the meeting are generally available on the Friday following the meeting.</p>
<p>Recordings of Council Meetings remain the property of Council. Permission from the Chief Executive Officer is required before any recording can be broadcast or distributed.</p>

<style>
:root {
  --msc-purple:        #50475a;
  --msc-purple-deep:   #3c3644;
  --msc-purple-bright: #736c7b;
  --msc-gold:         #f7961c;
  --msc-gold-soft:    #FFAD42;
  --msc-white:        #FFFFFF;
  --msc-line:         #E2E0D8;
  --msc-font: "Arial", Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
  /* Height of the Copilot Studio webchat's built-in header.
     Tune this until the hosted title bar is fully hidden
     and the conversation sits cleanly under your header. */
  --msc-crop: 64px;
  --msc-shadow-1: 0 2px 4px rgba(0,40,28,.14);
  --msc-shadow-2: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,40,28,.18);
  --msc-shadow-3: 0 18px 44px rgba(0,40,28,.26);
}

/* ----- Launcher: glossy 3D orb + label pill ----- */
.msc-va-launcher {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 26px;
  right: 60px;
  z-index: 9999;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 8px 22px 8px 8px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 18px !important;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--msc-purple) 0%, var(--msc-purple-deep) 100%);
  color: var(--msc-white);
  font-family: var(--msc-font);
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.25;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25) inset,
    0 -3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.25) inset,
    var(--msc-shadow-2),
    0 24px 40px -18px rgba(0,40,28,.45);
  animation: msc-va-float 3.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  transition: transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
}
.msc-va-launcher:hover,
.msc-va-launcher:focus-visible {
  transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.04);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--msc-purple-bright) 0%, var(--msc-purple) 100%);
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25) inset,
    0 -3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.25) inset,
    var(--msc-shadow-3),
    0 0 0 3px rgba(247,150,28,.55),
    0 0 24px rgba(247,150,28,.45);
  animation-play-state: paused;
  outline: none;
}
.msc-va-launcher:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--msc-gold); outline-offset: 3px; }

.msc-va-orb {
  position: relative;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 46px; height: 46px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 30% 25%, #FFE9A8 0%, var(--msc-gold-soft) 22%, var(--msc-gold) 55%, #B97F00 100%);
  box-shadow:
    inset -4px -6px 10px rgba(90,55,0,.45),
    inset 3px 4px 6px rgba(255,255,255,.55),
    0 5px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.30);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  transition: transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, filter .2s ease;
}
.msc-va-orb::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 5px; left: 9px;
  width: 16px; height: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.75);
  filter: blur(2px);
  transform: rotate(-22deg);
}
.msc-va-orb svg { width: 23px; height: 23px; fill: #3A2A00; position: relative; transition: transform .2s ease; }
.msc-va-launcher:hover .msc-va-orb,
.msc-va-launcher:focus-visible .msc-va-orb {
  transform: scale(1.12) rotate(-6deg);
  filter: brightness(1.12) saturate(1.15);
  box-shadow:
    inset -4px -6px 10px rgba(90,55,0,.45),
    inset 3px 4px 6px rgba(255,255,255,.65),
    0 5px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.35),
    0 0 18px rgba(247,150,28,.6);
}
.msc-va-launcher:hover .msc-va-orb svg,
.msc-va-launcher:focus-visible .msc-va-orb svg { transform: scale(1.1); }

.msc-va-label small { display: block; font-weight: 400; font-size: 12px; opacity: .9; }

.msc-va-launcher::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -2px; right: 4px;
  width: 12px; height: 12px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, var(--msc-gold-soft), var(--msc-gold) 70%);
  border: 2px solid var(--msc-purple-deep);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(242,169,0,.55);
  animation: msc-va-pulse 2.4s ease-out infinite;
}

@keyframes msc-va-float { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-7px); } }
@keyframes msc-va-pulse {
  0%   { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(242,169,0,.55); }
  70%  { box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgba(242,169,0,0); }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(242,169,0,0); }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .msc-va-launcher, .msc-va-launcher::after { animation: none; }
  .msc-va-launcher:hover, .msc-va-launcher:focus-visible { transform: none; }
}

/* ----- Chat panel ----- */
.msc-va-panel {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 26px;
  right: 26px;
  z-index: 10000;
  width: 410px;
  max-width: calc(100vw - 32px);
  height: 640px;

<script>
(function () {
  // ====== CONFIGURE: your Copilot Studio web channel URL ======
  // Copilot Studio > Channels > Custom website > copy the iframe src
  var BOT_URL = "https://copilotstudio.microsoft.com/environments/Default-178eb3ff-b26c-4882-bec3-48150c87263c/bots/crf5e_murrindindiCouncilAssistant/webchat?__version__=2";

  var launcher  = document.getElementById("mscVaLauncher");
  var panel     = document.getElementById("mscVaPanel");
  var frame     = document.getElementById("mscVaFrame");
  var closeBtn  = document.getElementById("mscVaClose");
  var loaded    = false;
  var lastFocus = null;

  function openChat() {
    if (!loaded) {                 // lazy-load: no iframe traffic until first open
      frame.src = BOT_URL;
      loaded = true;
    }
    lastFocus = document.activeElement;
    panel.hidden = false;
    panel.classList.add("msc-va-open");
    launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
    launcher.style.display = "none";
    closeBtn.focus();
  }

  function closeChat() {
    panel.classList.remove("msc-va-open");
    panel.hidden = true;
    launcher.style.display = "flex";
    launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    (lastFocus || launcher).focus();
  }

  launcher.addEventListener("click", openChat);
  closeBtn.addEventListener("click", closeChat);
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && panel.classList.contains("msc-va-open")) closeChat();
  });

  /* ====== OFFICE HOURS STATUS (green = open, red = closed) ======
     Computed in Australia/Melbourne time regardless of the visitor's
     device timezone. CONFIRM these hours against the Customer Service
     Charter before go-live, and update HOLIDAYS each year. */
  var HOURS = {
    // 0=Sun ... 6=Sat. null = closed all day. [openMins, closeMins] from midnight.
    0: null,
    1: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],   // Mon 8:30am – 5:00pm
    2: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    3: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    4: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    5: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],   // Fri
    6: null
  };
  // Victorian public holidays — maintain annually (Grand Final Friday TBC each year)
  var HOLIDAYS = [
    "2026-01-01", "2026-01-26", "2026-03-09",
    "2026-04-03", "2026-04-04", "2026-04-06", "2026-04-25",
    "2026-06-08", "2026-11-03", "2026-12-25", "2026-12-28"
  ];
  var PHONE = "(03) 5772 0333";

  function melbourneNow() {
    var parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
      timeZone: "Australia/Melbourne",
      year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit",
      hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: false, weekday: "short"
    }).formatToParts(new Date());
    var p = {};
    parts.forEach(function (x) { p[x.type] = x.value; });
    var days = { Sun: 0, Mon: 1, Tue: 2, Wed: 3, Thu: 4, Fri: 5, Sat: 6 };
    return {
      dateStr: p.year + "-" + p.month + "-" + p.day,
      day: days[p.weekday],
      mins: parseInt(p.hour, 10) * 60 + parseInt(p.minute, 10)
    };
  }

  function updateHours() {
    var pill = document.getElementById("mscVaHours");
    var text = document.getElementById("mscVaHoursText");
    if (!pill || !text) return;
    var now = melbourneNow();
    var span = HOURS[now.day];
    var isHoliday = HOLIDAYS.indexOf(now.dateStr) !== -1;
    var open = !isHoliday && span && now.mins >= span[0] && now.mins < span[1];
    pill.classList.toggle("is-open", open);
    pill.classList.toggle("is-closed", !open);
    text.textContent = open
      ? "Council offices are open"
      : "Council offices are closed \u2013 I\u2019m here 24/7, or call " + PHONE;
  }

  updateHours();
  setInterval(updateHours, 60000); // re-check every minute
})();
</script>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Agendas and Minutes</h1>

<p>Murrindindi Shire Council holds a Council Meeting on the fourth Wednesday of each month, starting at 6.00 pm. From time to time, an unscheduled Council Meeting may also be held. Any additional meetings will be advertised on this website.</p>
<p>Council Meeting agendas are generally available for download on the Friday before the meeting. Minutes and the audio recording of the meeting are generally available on the Friday following the meeting.</p>
<p>Recordings of Council Meetings remain the property of Council. Permission from the Chief Executive Officer is required before any recording can be broadcast or distributed.</p>

<script>
(function () {
  // ====== CONFIGURE: your Copilot Studio web channel URL ======
  // Copilot Studio > Channels > Custom website > copy the iframe src
  var BOT_URL = "https://copilotstudio.microsoft.com/environments/Default-178eb3ff-b26c-4882-bec3-48150c87263c/bots/crf5e_murrindindiCouncilAssistant/webchat?__version__=2";

  var launcher  = document.getElementById("mscVaLauncher");
  var panel     = document.getElementById("mscVaPanel");
  var frame     = document.getElementById("mscVaFrame");
  var closeBtn  = document.getElementById("mscVaClose");
  var loaded    = false;
  var lastFocus = null;

  function openChat() {
    if (!loaded) {                 // lazy-load: no iframe traffic until first open
      frame.src = BOT_URL;
      loaded = true;
    }
    lastFocus = document.activeElement;
    panel.hidden = false;
    panel.classList.add("msc-va-open");
    launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
    launcher.style.display = "none";
    closeBtn.focus();
  }

  function closeChat() {
    panel.classList.remove("msc-va-open");
    panel.hidden = true;
    launcher.style.display = "flex";
    launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    (lastFocus || launcher).focus();
  }

  launcher.addEventListener("click", openChat);
  closeBtn.addEventListener("click", closeChat);
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && panel.classList.contains("msc-va-open")) closeChat();
  });

  /* ====== OFFICE HOURS STATUS (green = open, red = closed) ======
     Computed in Australia/Melbourne time regardless of the visitor's
     device timezone. CONFIRM these hours against the Customer Service
     Charter before go-live, and update HOLIDAYS each year. */
  var HOURS = {
    // 0=Sun ... 6=Sat. null = closed all day. [openMins, closeMins] from midnight.
    0: null,
    1: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],   // Mon 8:30am – 5:00pm
    2: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    3: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    4: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],
    5: [8 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60],   // Fri
    6: null
  };
  // Victorian public holidays — maintain annually (Grand Final Friday TBC each year)
  var HOLIDAYS = [
    "2026-01-01", "2026-01-26", "2026-03-09",
    "2026-04-03", "2026-04-04", "2026-04-06", "2026-04-25",
    "2026-06-08", "2026-11-03", "2026-12-25", "2026-12-28"
  ];
  var PHONE = "(03) 5772 0333";

  function melbourneNow() {
    var parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
      timeZone: "Australia/Melbourne",
      year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit",
      hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: false, weekday: "short"
    }).formatToParts(new Date());
    var p = {};
    parts.forEach(function (x) { p[x.type] = x.value; });
    var days = { Sun: 0, Mon: 1, Tue: 2, Wed: 3, Thu: 4, Fri: 5, Sat: 6 };
    return {
      dateStr: p.year + "-" + p.month + "-" + p.day,
      day: days[p.weekday],
      mins: parseInt(p.hour, 10) * 60 + parseInt(p.minute, 10)
    };
  }

  function updateHours() {
    var pill = document.getElementById("mscVaHours");
    var text = document.getElementById("mscVaHoursText");
    if (!pill || !text) return;
    var now = melbourneNow();
    var span = HOURS[now.day];
    var isHoliday = HOLIDAYS.indexOf(now.dateStr) !== -1;
    var open = !isHoliday && span && now.mins >= span[0] && now.mins < span[1];
    pill.classList.toggle("is-open", open);
    pill.classList.toggle("is-closed", !open);
    text.textContent = open
      ? "Council offices are open"
      : "Council offices are closed \u2013 I\u2019m here 24/7, or call " + PHONE;
  }

  updateHours();
  setInterval(updateHours, 60000); // re-check every minute
})();
</script>
